notes: Calibrated from the initial 32-scenario corpus run on the snapshot-fixed replay engine (feat/eval-corpus-gates, Sep 2026). Correctness gates are zero-tolerance product promises from the build spec: no false alerts on normal air, no silent misses on follower patterns, byte-identical determinism, restart equivalence, inert display rendering. worst_latency_cycles=2 is the observed corpus-wide slowest first detection (evil twins at the twin's cycle, co-travel at the second stop). It is set to the exact observed value on purpose: replay is deterministic, so any move of this number is a behavior change that must be reviewed and re-calibrated, never auto-waived.
